source_assertions.title: Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events
source_assertions.raw_file: horary_knowledge/Horary Astrology and the Judgment of Events (Barbara H. Watters) (Z-Library).txt
source_assertions.claim: Watters says that after a glorious beginning the attrition of Saturn in the South's sixth house would take over, that blockade and supply strain would grow, and that Grant's strategy made the Civil War a textbook case of widening campaign pressure.
